name: RoboX EgoGrasp v0.1
tagline: 10-clip sample (92 s, 2 people) of iPhone ego grasps: 21-joint hand keypoints, grasp segments, IMU, 6-DoF pose; 1,800+ on request.

annotations.format: JSONL (clips index, per-frame hand keypoints, actions, sensors, object tracks) + JSON manifests
annotations.coverageNote: All 10 clips have hand keypoints, action segments and sensor streams; object tracks for 1/10 clips. Labels are Gemini-2.5-flash-lite generated, human-verified.

narrations.note: One AI-generated narration sentence per clip in clips.jsonl

action_labels.note: grasp / idle segments with start/end sec and frames

object_boxes.note: Normalized boxes + class per frame in object_tracks (1 of 10 clips)

hand_pose.note: 21 joints 2D + 3D world per hand, grip type, finger curl angles

body_pose.note: App captures body pose but it is not exported in this sample

camera_pose.note: ARKit 6-DoF pose, velocity and 3x3 intrinsics per frame (sensors.jsonl)

qa_language.note: Object / grip / scene labels per clip (labels block)
